where: Section 1 (absolute humidity); repeated in exam trap 2
problem: The text says absolute humidity (g/m³) 'stays the same when air is heated or cooled, provided no water enters or leaves'. That is only true for a sealed, fixed volume. Air heated at constant pressure expands, so the same mass of vapour fills a larger volume and the g/m³ value falls slightly. Only dew point (and vapour partial pressure) is truly unchanged by heating.
fix: Rewrite as: 'In a sealed volume it stays the same when the air is heated or cooled. In an open room at constant pressure, warming makes the air expand, so the grams per cubic metre fall a little.' In exam trap 2, say the dew point is unchanged and the absolute humidity is nearly unchanged; the main change is in RH.

problem: The cross-reference 'see 5.7' is plain text, so on the phone it is not tappable like the other chapter links in the book.
fix: Write it as a link: 'that is a smart sensor, see 5.7'.
